text: Botany is a fundamental science that studies the morphology, growth and development, physiological metabolism, genetic evolution, classification and distribution of plants, as well as their interactions with the environment. It is an important branch of life science. It not only explores the life laws of plants themselves, but also reveals the core roles of plants in ecosystems, agricultural production, medical research and other fields. It is a key discipline for understanding the material circulation and biodiversity in nature.
